profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Hyve Solutions
profile.summary:
- A passionate software developer who is actively seeking challenging and engaging software problems which offer self-growth potentials, where I can put my skills and experience to effective use. I see myself as highly flexible and adaptable with strong research and problem analysis skills.

- A recent Computer Science graduate from California State University, East Bay (GPA: 3.96 / 4.0) with hand-on, professional experience working on multi-platform game development and front-end web development. I also have strong knowledge in computer architecture, computer assembly and computer's performance maintenance. 

- Proficient with C/C++, Java, C#,  HTML, JavaScript, data structure and algorithms, object-oriented programming, game development tools (Unity, GameMaker Studio), Android SDK, Android Studio, Git version control, Linux/UNIX environments.

- Efficient knowledge in relational database (SQLite, MySQL), back-end web development, PHP, machine learning, networking (TCP/IP), operating systems. 

- Check out my Github account for relevant projects I have been working on: https://github.com/ThongNguyen95

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Designed and developed software solutions utilized in quality validation and configuration of server components, storage drives, and networking systems.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams across the U.S. and internationally for strategic implementation of software solutions for customized datacenter products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed scalable datacenter test infrastructure, automating multi-stage performance tests, remote services with focus on networking systems, strategically reducing application runtime by 75% and increasing manufacturing productivity and shipping capabilities.
• Performed software-related monitoring, debugging, maintenance and enhancements in a highly fast-paced manufacturing environment, in a timely manner with high efficiency.
• Utilized tools such as Linux/UNIX, Python, Docker, Ansible, Git, MySQL, REST APIs, and Jira.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with engineers and designers to build core game logic and standalone software tools for character-and-level-development in “The End of The Line: New Age” project.
• Worked across development phases using Unity and C# to support game production and maintenance.

positions.title: Independent Game Developer
positions.description:
• Developed multi-platform video games across genres: educational, puzzle, platformer, action-based RPG, horror and survival.
• Responsible for game logic, level design, storytelling, and animation.
• Games are developed using Unity, GameMaker Studio 2, and HTML5 Phaser game engines.
• Supported platforms including mobile (Android), PC, and webpage.
• Utilized programming languages such as C++, C#, JavaScript, and Python.
• Invited to participate in the Game Development World Championship 2020.

positions.title: Computer Technical Specialist
positions.description:
• Providing computer software/hardware diagnosis, repairing and consulting services.
• Providing computer desktop system custom-building service based on customer's needs and preferences. 
• Recognized by customers for quick, friendly, and upstanding services, custom-built systems with high quality, functionality and excellent cost-performance value.

positions.title: Website Developer & Graphic Designer
positions.description:
• Design, develop, regularly maintain and update Le Soleil Day Spa’s website, constantly enhance its quality and standard by actively improving my own technical knowledge, experience and by learning new tools, technologies.
• Design and create Le Soleil Day Spa’s logos, business cards, brochures, and newsletters with the goal of effectively amplifying business popularity, sales and customer relation.

projects.title: 2D Action-RPG Platformer
projects.description:
- Action-RPG, side-scrolling platformer Windows game project with flexible AI, choice-driven storytelling and dynamic character development system.
- Developed with GameMaker Studio 2 engine.

projects.title: D.O.T.S - Connecting Those Dots
projects.description:
A short puzzle game I developed as a personal Phaser 3 project based on this popular Dots game:

https://www.dots.co/dots/

The goal is to connect all adjacent dots of the same color to clear them out. The longer the connected line, the more points you can score. Making a loop by connecting them would clear out all dots of that same color.
